name: What can go wrong if I ignore a small repair around the house?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong if I ignore a small repair around the house?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are moisture damage, hidden structural problems, repeated failures, and making the repair worse with a quick cosmetic fix. In Colorado homes, water management around windows, siding, gutters, and foundations matters because drainage problems can lead to rot and interior damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ignored repairs can turn into rot, leaks, structural damage, or repeated failures. Water and drainage issues are especially risky in Colorado homes.
